content:
Apple TV today revealed a trailer for the new show "Last Seen," a thriller that will kick off the streaming platform's fall slate next month.

"Last Seen" premieres on September 9 and is Apple's latest thriller series.

Apple TV has plenty to watch in the coming months. "Ted Lasso" is already back, the sci-fi series "Dark Matter" is about to return, and there are plenty of other compelling shows and movies.

One of those new shows, "Last Seen," just released its official trailer.

"Last Seen" will debut its first two episodes on September 9 (Wednesday), then release weekly until concluding on October 7.

This Australian thriller stars Patrick Brammall as a police call center operator who receives a desperate phone call from a woman reported missing 11 years ago.

Here's Apple's official synopsis, followed by the trailer:

"Last Seen" is based on the novel "The Dispatcher" by award-winning author Ryan David Jahn (Amazon link here).

Will you be watching when "Last Seen" premieres? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and you can get a discount by bundling it with Apple One.
